_comment: SIFT-1M (128d L2). Anchored on (recall, build_speed): head_ratio=0.25 (vs 0.2) widens the in-memory head index — old SPANN-SIFT-1M baseline was recall=0.9748, the +25% head plus posting_page_limit=16 (vs 12) and max_check=16384 (vs 4096) push it to >=0.99. internal_result_num=128 (vs 64) widens search-time candidate pool. num_threads/io_threads=32 cuts build wall-clock vs old 16. replica_count=8 unchanged (matches SPANN paper SIFT-1B sweet spot).
